summary: Lazy one-time initialization of an audio renderer. On first call it checks a byte flag at this+0xAF0; if set, initialization is already done and it returns 0. If a stored audio object at this+0xAF4 is already non-null, or the global InitStatus object dword_8AC4C4 is null, it returns 1. Otherwise it creates the audio object through a thiscall virtual dispatch at vtable slot +96 on dword_8AC4C4, stores the result at this+0xAF4, returns 1 if creation failed, then runs three post-init steps (threshold-gated virtual dispatch, a cleanup/no-op wrapper, and a computation over the memory cleanup list) and marks this+0xAF0 = 1 before returning 0. Called from Sound_Enter.

local_names.v2: created audio object handle from virtual dispatch

operations.description: If byte at this+0xAF0 is non-zero (already initialized) return 0 (success).
If dword at this+0xAF4 is non-zero (stored audio object present) return 1 (fail).
If global dword_8AC4C4 (init status object) is null return 1 (no object to dispatch on).
Thiscall virtual dispatch on dword_8AC4C4 through its vtable slot +96 to create the audio object.
Store the virtual dispatch result into this+0xAF4 as the audio object handle.
If the virtual dispatch result is zero (object creation failed) return 1.
ThresholdGatedVirtualDispatch(flt_7CF3C8): virtual dispatch gated by the track condition global.
ShortComputation_5090(&dword_5EA5E8): operates on the memory cleanup list global.
Set byte at this+0xAF0 to 1, marking initialization complete.
Return 0 on success (already initialized or freshly initialized).
Return 1 on all failure/not-ready paths (stored object present, init status null, or object creation failed).
